main.description: ADR-2604261717 Phase 1 — finalize a staked claim. Path A (no challenge filed within challengePeriod): anyone can call to refund the bond and close the claim. Path B (challenged): the configured arbiter signs the outcome via ECDSA over keccak256(claimId, claimWins, escrow, chainId) and the contract distributes per the 85/10/5 split. Path C (no-show, arbiter timed out): both sides refunded.

claimWins.description: Required when arbiterSig is supplied (Path B)

arbiterSig.description: 0x-prefixed 65-byte ECDSA signature from the configured arbiter address. Required for Path B.
